Running command: cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 60, "var": "data[0]", "code": "if (GET_MOD_EQ(4,0)) format=\"json\"; ... else format=\"logfmt\";", "note": "data[0]=3 selects the logfmt parser format; MOVE_INPUT(1) advances past the format byte."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 108, "var": "types", "code": "if (GET_MOD_EQ(2,1)) { types = flb_malloc(...); types[2].key=\"CCC\"; types[2].type=FLB_PARSER_TYPE_BOOL; }", "note": "data[5]=1 (odd) enables parser types; key \"CCC\" is registered with BOOL type so typecast will compare values against \"true\"/\"false\"."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 151, "var": "data", "code": "flb_parser_do(fuzz_parser, (char*)data, size, &out_buf, &out_size, &out_time);", "note": "The remaining attacker-controlled bytes (ending with \"CCC=t\") are passed as the logfmt record to be parsed."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/flb_parser_logfmt.c", "function": "logfmt_parser", "line": 118, "var": "key/value", "code": "key = c; while ((c < end) && ident_byte[*c]) c++; ... value = c; while ((c < end) && ident_byte[*c]) c++;", "note": "Parses key \"CCC\" (key_len=3) and value \"t\" (value_len=1); value points to the final byte of the heap buffer."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/flb_parser_logfmt.c", "function": "logfmt_parser", "line": 158, "var": "flb_parser_typecast", "code": "flb_parser_typecast((const char*) key, key_len, (const char*) value, value_len, tmp_pck, parser->types, parser->types_len);", "note": "Because types_len != 0, the key/value pair is passed to typecast; key \"CCC\" matches the BOOL type entry."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/flb_parser.c", "function": "flb_parser_typecast", "line": 884, "var": "val", "code": "if (!strncasecmp(val, \"true\", 4)) { msgpack_pack_true(pck); }", "note": "val points to the 1-byte value \"t\" at the end of the heap buffer; strncasecmp reads 4 bytes, matching 't' then reading 1 byte past the buffer -> heap-buffer-overflow READ 1."}
]
EOF
echo "trace written"; python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('valid json')"
